candidate_findings.status: Source-backed conditional no-hit contract and consumer question; central owns alias, count and supported placement policy.
candidate_findings.trigger_and_source: MeshCollider::query at collider.rs:134–137 returns (reach, Vec3::up()) if TriangleBvh::closest_point finds nothing within reach. bvh/cpu/mod.rs:302–324 bounds distances by reach squared; creator groom.rs:19–21,103–125 passes reach=0.1 m to a mesh built from body faces and positions.
candidate_findings.inside_reasoning: For a valid closed cube centered at the origin with faces 0.2 m from its center, a center point is inside and its nearest surface is 0.2 m away. With reach 0.1 m no triangle qualifies; the no-hit tuple is positive 0.1 m. push_out with offset below 0.1 returns without correction despite the deep interior point. This is geometric reasoning only, not an instantiated fixture or runtime result.
candidate_findings.cap_consumer_reasoning: Creator groom.rs:164–176 passes this CPU MeshCollider to ScalpCap::fit, not to the separate GPU LOD body field. cap.rs:68–87 always computes carried − out*(distance−CAP_LIFT); CAP_LIFT is 0.0004 m. On any no-hit, it uses synthetic up and 0.1 m as if measured, producing a 0.0996 m downward displacement even if the actual nearest surface is elsewhere. clear_skin is bounded sampled postprocessing and is not proven to repair that condition. A cap vertex missing the search radius in any ordinary model has not been demonstrated.
candidate_findings.impact_and_policy: The tuple loses whether a real signed measurement was obtained. The current code explicitly documents no-hit as far outside; correctness therefore depends on a caller placement/reach precondition or explicit no-hit handling. No final visual geometry, actual user impact or runtime result is claimed.
candidate_findings.future_direction: Specify and check the supported query domain and no-hit semantics end to end; a consumer that must project may require an actual closest point or a structured miss. Preserve deliberate no-obstacle behavior and native fast paths where their preconditions hold. Implementation and alias decisions remain central.

candidate_findings.status: Concrete source-math elaboration of 059 unresolved sampled versus continuous clearance; no automatically separate count.
candidate_findings.condition: For a first 0.08 m straight segment on x-axis from x=0 to x=0.08, exact signed distance to a sphere centered at x=0.01 of radius 0.004 m, and clearance 0.0015 m. Root x=0 is outside with signed distance 0.006 m. No collider or polyline fixture is constructed or run.
candidate_findings.reasoning: The sphere intersects the segment over x=0.006–0.014. Endpoint minimum 0.006 minus half-segment reach 0.04 is below clearance, so the segment is sampled. Samples at x=0.02,0.04,0.06 have signed distances 0.006,0.026,0.046 m, all above 0.0015; any stays false and the function returns with the crossing unchanged, regardless of a positive pass budget. The argument assumes exact sphere signed-distance values and concerns the trait-permitted geometric class, not a demonstrated generated hairstyle.
candidate_findings.connected_callers: Current cards.rs:131–133 calls keep_clear with 0.0015 m and 4 passes when body is present; lod.rs:157–163 uses it for resampled host strand levels. The creator groom.rs:173–176 uses GPU LOD body field and CPU mesh collider for cap, so no claim that that creator passes MeshCollider into the host cards/LOD paths.
candidate_findings.future_direction: Decide whether the public comment and consuming product require continuous segment clearance or an explicit sampled approximation with bounded error. If stricter, address interval/contact admission and residual reporting while preserving the fixed root and legitimate no-collider sentinel.
candidate_findings.historical_qualification: 059 READ-L11-432 already recorded that three samples do not prove full clearance; 059 READ-L13-PARALLEL-105 separately raises sampled cap triangles, not the same function. Exact ledger alias and distinctness are centrally owned.

nonfindings: NoCollider returns (+infinity, up) intentionally; a no-obstacle sentinel is not by itself a malformed finite-distance input.
keep_clear returns for fewer than two points and fixes index0 during its pushes; a zero-pass call is a bounded no-op, whose policy must be interpreted in context.
All-NoCollider shrinkwrap points give zero weights and early return before movement is applied; this does not witness the earlier mixed-distance condition.
MeshCollider stores its copied mesh and BVH privately with no mutation method in the assigned source; no stale-cache mutation is demonstrated.
Clipping at finite reach may be valid for callers that have established outside/near-surface preconditions; no universally supported inside or far placement is assumed.
open_questions: What precondition proves every creator carried cap point lies within the 0.1 m mesh query reach, and how should a genuine miss be reported or handled?
What continuous clearance guarantee versus sampled tolerance is required by cards, host strand LOD, and scalp cap consumers, and are their actual geometric bounds sufficient?
What BodySurface, normals, winding, degeneracy and index admission occurs before MeshCollider construction on each real route?
Are there shipped Collider implementations producing mixed finite and infinite distances, and how do prior shrinkwrap/F054/F074 candidates alias or differ?
What are complete GPU field, shader, render and final image effects? These were not executed or validated.

lenses.name: producer-propagation
lenses.assessment: Creator GroomedHair::place constructs MeshCollider from body positions/faces and 0.1 m reach and sends it to ScalpCap::fit; GPU LOD instead uses a separate body-field buffer. Separately inspected host cards/LOD call generic keep_clear.

lenses.name: existing-type-owners
lenses.assessment: Hair Collider represents a CPU signed-query interface and NoCollider absence; shared TriangleBvh stores mesh acceleration, while creator BodyField serves a separate native representation. Identical collider names alone do not establish interchangeable authorities.

lenses.name: admission-contracts
lenses.assessment: MeshCollider::new passes raw positions/triangles first into vertex_normals indexing; no local index-membership guard is seen. Existing F054 covers connected mesh/BVH topology admission. Finite reach has an explicit no-hit fallback that cannot decide deep inside versus far outside.

lenses.name: invariant-operations
lenses.assessment: push_out uses at most six corrections; keep_clear uses a caller-supplied number of passes, endpoint shortcut and three internal samples. Bounded iterations ensure termination for finite passes but do not certify continuous clearance or residual absence.

lenses.name: aggregate-states
lenses.assessment: Mesh indices require position and normal membership, BVH must correspond to stored triangles, and positive reach/no-hit must be understood by each query consumer. No proof of ordinary inconsistent producer state or actual no-hit cap occurrence is claimed.

lenses.name: type-ownership
lenses.assessment: MeshCollider owns private positions/normals/triangles/BVH and a signed query; body-field, GPU collider and NoCollider absence have differing semantics. F054 topology and finite-reach query outcomes require connected but distinct context.

lenses.name: redundant-authority
lenses.assessment: Private MeshCollider carries source geometry alongside a BVH cloned from it; with no mutation API in assessed body the copies begin associated. No stale-cache witness is established for this private type; separate mutable TriangleBvh and Surface concerns remain existing F054/F074.

lenses.name: behavior-preservation
lenses.assessment: Assigned source bytes match 6533 and 95e per file, with independently displayed full bodies. Original historical reviewer scopes excluded MeshCollider lines112–164; our new historical display does not retroactively expand theirs.

lenses.name: enum-shapes
lenses.assessment: NoCollider deliberately represents no obstacle as +infinity/up. A mesh search miss and a measured signed surface point currently share one tuple representation; whether to expose an explicit no-hit outcome is an open API decision.

lenses.name: derivability
lenses.assessment: Assigned Collider trait and private-state mesh struct contain no manual serializer or trait boilerplate shown to be safely derivable.

lenses.name: type-granularity
lenses.assessment: Signed distance, nonnegative reach, clearance, signed position, outward unit direction and unbounded absence sentinel carry distinct contracts. Positive infinity is intentional NoCollider behavior, not automatically invalid.

lenses.name: magic-strings
lenses.assessment: No business-string selector or string-valued API appears in collider.rs. Error and native binding families remain in their own producer/consumer scopes.

lenses.name: magic-numbers
lenses.assessment: Six push-out attempts, three segment samples, four host passes and 0.1 m reach are different operational tolerances/limits. Name or wrap them only with preserved geometric meaning; they do not themselves prove continuous clearance or no-hit validity.
